title: Zombie Apocalypse Part 1 - The Ration
notes: Interior, metres. Room spans x -4..4, z -2.55..3.55, ceiling 3.05. Camera stays on an arc in FRONT of the props (z >= 1.25) and uses a long lens rather than flying closer. No motionFloor/holdDrift overrides: onecam derives them from scene scale and then per beat from each beat subject distance. An explicit 0.07 here left the far beats motionless for up to 2s.

beats.name: window
beats.content: READ 1 - something is wrong outside. Boarded window, cold light in slats. A shape crosses it, once, unclear.

beats.name: find-them
beats.content: READ 2 - two people are in here. The camera pulls back and finds them: the human first, then Claude. Both still, both listening.
beats.narration: We stopped counting the ones outside.

beats.name: shelf
beats.content: READ 3 - there is almost no food. Held long enough to count the cans, because they are countable. That is the point.

beats.name: hands
beats.content: READ 4 - they are dividing it. Cans moved into two piles. One is larger, and it is not Claude's. Plays silent, deliberately.

beats.name: the-look
beats.content: READ 5 - Claude notices, and says nothing. THIS IS THE FILM. The read is the reaction, not the act. Closest shot of the piece.
beats.narration: He gave me the bigger pile.

beats.name: the-turn
beats.content: READ 6 - it is not over. A sound outside; both heads turn. The film ends on the turn, not after it.
